items.name: Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval
items.type: (R : Type u) {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [Algebra R S₁] (f : σ → S₁) : Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range f) = (MvPolynomial.aeval f).range

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_range
items.type: {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [Algebra R S₁] (f : σ → S₁) : (MvPolynomial.aeval f).range = Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range f)

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_X

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_def
items.type: {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [Algebra R S₁] (f : σ → S₁) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : (MvPolynomial.aeval f) p = MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap R S₁) f p
